Secure a SOLID 8% Return with Montgomery County, Alabama Tax Lien Investing

Want a SOLID 8% interest rate on your investment? Check out the Montgomery County Tax Sale. This sale takes place in person at the Montgomery County Commission Chambers, Courthouse Annex III, 101 South Lawrence Street. It’s not just any sale; it’s an opportunity to invest directly in tax liens with the promise of a solid return.

The auction runs between 10 AM and 4 PM. Check the Revenue Commissioner’s page in April for the exact date and registration process details.

Here’s how it works: properties are auctioned to the highest bidder. It’s straightforward, direct competition for a chance to earn an 8% return on your investment.

But there’s more. If the property goes into redemption, you, as the investor, have a three-year window. This means if the original owner settles their debt within three years, you receive your investment back plus the interest accrued. If not, you can file for foreclosure on the property and own it.

Montgomery County Tax Sale Information

Important Details

Steps to Start Tax Lien Investing in Montgomery County

  1. Research and Understand Local Laws

    It’s essential to know the legal framework in Montgomery County before investing. Key regulations and procedures can be found on the Montgomery County Revenue Commissioner’s website.
  2. Visit the Local Treasurer’s Website

    The Revenue Commissioner’s website provides information about upcoming tax sales, registration processes, and auction schedules.
  3. Check the Auction Site

    Visit the Montgomery County Auction Site for details on properties up for auction.
  4. Contact the County Office

    For additional inquiries, you can contact the Montgomery County Revenue Commissioner’s office. Here are some useful contacts:
  • Phone: 334-832-1250
  • Email: ALLYSONHOLLAND@MC-ALA.ORG
  • Address: 101 South Lawrence Street, Montgomery, AL 36104

Pro Tips

  • Start Small: Begin with a small investment to get familiar with the process.
  • Do Your Homework: Research each property thoroughly before bidding.
  • Keep Records: Maintain detailed records of all your transactions and communications.

Why Invest in Montgomery County?

High Returns with Low Risk: The 8% interest rate provides a reliable return on investment, especially when compared to traditional investments.

Potential for Property Ownership: The 3-year redemption period offers a unique advantage—if the property isn’t redeemed, you could end up owning it.

Open to All Investors: Whether you’re a local or a foreign investor, Montgomery County allows a wide range of participation.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

Q: What is a Tax Lien?

A: A tax lien is a claim the government makes on a property when the property owner fails to pay their property taxes. Investors can buy these liens at auction and earn interest if the property owner pays off the debt.

Q: How Long is the Redemption Period in Montgomery County?

A: The redemption period is three years. During this time, the property owner can repay the debt plus interest to redeem their property.

Q: What Happens if the Property is Not Redeemed?

A: If the property is not redeemed within three years, the investor can initiate foreclosure proceedings and potentially acquire the property.
